text: Record [[attendance]] daily for every [[class]]; unrecorded absences must be flagged to staff before end of day.
Invoices are generated monthly; each invoice applies any approved [[subsidy]] before the total is shown #billing.
[[learning-note]]s must be tied to documented developmental [[milestones]] and kept free of judgmental language.
Never share a child's data — attendance, notes, or invoices — across families #privacy.
Send gentle reminders for overdue [[invoice]]s before escalating; tone stays supportive #billing.
Term dates and public holidays are sourced from the [[calendar]]; all scheduling decisions defer to it.
Unexplained absences — no prior notice and no same-day contact — must be escalated to the [[class]] coordinator.
All records are accurate, up-to-date, and stored in the approved location before the end of each working day.
